direction_feedback: Le joueur trouve le nouveau manteau beau et demande de se concentrer sur le design des armures.

entries.label: Très légère
entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the attached HEADLESS Technomancien technical-coat body.
Create one NEW original outfit design at the protection level described below while keeping the machine-technician class identity: large continuous petrol-teal protective garment, warm copper prosthetic forearms and feet, charcoal structural parts, one simple rectangular control unit with amber bar, front-facing empty lowered hands. This is an almost entirely robotic human engineer. No exposed human skin.
The torso outfit is a COMPLETE neck-to-feet design: both sleeves, forearms/hands, trousers or coat panels, shins and boots must suit this specific protection level. Keep the same actual robot body proportions and stance under the garment; extra protection can make the silhouette wider. A separate fixed head is composed later. Draw only a SHORT charcoal neck stump through complete feet; omit the entire head and face.
CRITICAL native64 readability: the body will be only 48 pixels tall. Very few LARGE matte shapes, clear 2-3 tone volume shading, deliberate dark outlines and empty spaces, distinct hands and feet, no scattered exposed joints, ribcage grids, thin struts, tiny fingers, rivets, decorative panels or microtexture. Keep a technician's garment-based silhouette with stiff straight cuts and a visible front slit, NOT a warrior in white muscle-shaped plate armor. Teal should remain bright enough on dark flooring. Warm metal limbs are simple solid housings. No weapon, helmet, hood, tool, drone, extra limb, spikes, emblems, aura, cast shadow or text.
The attached image is the MEDIUM identity reference, not a mold whose garment length or boot design must stay unchanged. Follow the requested different cut and armor coverage. Full isolated body centered on a genuinely transparent background, generous transparent margins, no vignette or grey halo. No cropping at shoulders, hands or soles.
Design 01 VERY LIGHT: a SHORT lightweight petrol-teal mechanic's jacket ending at the upper thighs, open in the middle over a simple charcoal chest with one small flat amber console. Soft three-quarter sleeves, no shoulder armor, no chest cuirass, no shin armor. Large bare copper robotic forearms with simple hands. Straight charcoal work-trouser casings on the robotic legs with very little division, close-set short ankle boots with small copper toe caps. Compact practical worker silhouette, clear dark legs visible below the short jacket. The copper forearms are the body, not heavy armor. The original long coat MUST become a short jacket. Keep everything broad and very simple at final 64px.

entries.label: Très lourde
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached headless Technomancien body into the final VERY HEAVY armor tier.
The current image still reads as a cloth laboratory coat. Replace it with a HARD RIGID INDUSTRIAL ARMORED OVERCOAT, keeping its distinctive long split-coat silhouette and teal/copper/charcoal identity. This must visibly look like solid protection, with no cloth folds.
Four required major changes:
1. A WIDE thick squared graphite shoulder bridge and chest shell, integrated into the upper coat, with one broad amber console. Wide architectural shapes, no tiny panel grid.
2. TWO huge hard petrol-teal armor slabs forming the coat fronts down to below the knees, with thick dark exposed side edges and a wide split between them. Straight stiff armored edges. These large hard front panels must dominate the body.
3. MUCH bigger square COPPER armored forearm-and-gauntlet housings, covering the wrists and hands almost fully. Each arm housing about twice the present thickness, simple dark mitten-like fingers below the gauntlet.
4. Fully enclosed dark armored shins with broad copper front guards and very wide heavy copper/graphite boots. They are different from the reference's light shoes.
At a final 48 pixel neck-to-feet body height, make the real new silhouette 34-36 pixels wide (about 72% as wide as body height), by drawing thicker protective casings. Preserve actual robot body height, neck on centerline, two arms and two legs, empty lowered hands and front-facing posture. Do not stretch or shorten anatomy.
Beautiful original cyberpunk machine-technician equipment, not white warrior plate armor. LARGE readable masses only, at most three broad shading values per material. No fabric texture, small joints, straps, buckles, cables, rivets or added micro-details. Small charcoal hinge gaps at elbows and knees are enough.
Omit head, face, helmet, hood, weapons, handheld tools, drones, backpack or extra limbs. Entire isolated module from short neck stump through both soles, generous clear transparent margins, no cut hands/feet. Genuinely transparent background; no aura, shadow, vignette, text or labels.
